attributes.readMe:
# Generate Interview Questions Command

## Summary
Builds a recruiter prompt from the candidate's applied role, skills, resume, and an optional focus area, runs a one-shot LLM request, and writes the markdown question kit to `candidate.generatedQuestions`.

## Import
```ts
import { GenerateInterviewQuestionsCommand } from './commands/generate-interview-questions-command';
```

## Usage
```ts
await new GenerateInterviewQuestionsCommand(commandContext).execute({
  candidate,
  focusArea: 'system design',
});
```
